title: Subscription based
body: Nothing gets your app deleted quicker than a subscription being subscription-based. Don’t even gives us a free version. No thanks.

title: Hyrule
body: Unless Ganon completely redesigned the kingdom while nobody was looking, this layout bears zero resemblance to any Hyrule I’ve ever traversed. If you don't have access to the authentic Zelda texture pack, it's honestly better not to bother. One star is the lowest I can go, but my heart says zero.

title: Would be nice to have a free tier
body: Would love to experience this without having to do a weekly or yearly pay so I can see if I like it. Yes there’s a 7 day free period but I know me and I’ll forget to cancel it if I don’t use it within that time period.

title: Someone Finally Made GTA Maps a Reality
body: If you’re curious about this app, I’d recommend trying the 7-day free trial and canceling immediately so you don’t forget and get charged. Right now, they’re offering lifetime access for around $50, which honestly isn’t bad if the app continues improving. So far, it’s actually pretty useful. Kinda like Google Maps, but with a different interface and a GTA-style map. It already highlights nearby restaurants, bars, coffee shops, grocery stores, and other places worth checking out, without having to search for everything individually. I wish I can upload screenshots to show. I haven’t tested how accurate the real-time traffic or navigation features are compared to Google Maps or Waze, so I can’t speak on that yet. But as far as exploring your surroundings and discovering places nearby, it’s surprisingly practical. It’s more than just a cool-looking GTA map. There’s actually some functionality behind it. Would I pay $50 for lifetime access? If they keep updating it and improving the navigation, I could definitely see it being worth it.

title: Wow
body: If you are a gamer this is a must have map. It makes looking at the maps fun and the themes are awesome.
